name: When should I bring in plumbing coordination on a remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I bring in plumbing coordination on a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to involve plumbing coordination is before demolition ends and well before rough-in work starts. That gives the team time to verify fixture specs, confirm pipe routes, identify valve requirements, and make sure cabinets or countertops won’t block access later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bring it in early, before rough-in and ideally before demolition is finished. Early coordination helps catch fixture, layout, and access issues before they become expensive changes.
